verdict.rationale: Gitea's own marketing says it offers webhooks for building custom workflows, so the capability is first-party. The evidence is a single thin mention with no detail on event types, registration or payloads. The Slack/Discord/Teams sync does not count as programmatic webhooks. Missing for 10: documented list of subscribable events, how to register a webhook (UI or API), payload format and signing/secret verification, delivery and retry behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Extend Gitea's functionality with our API and webhooks, creating custom workflows to match your unique needs.
